decisions.statement: The flags a call has are judged before a day is read.
A day's rows are copied before an act changes a row.
Two days one act changes land in a single commit.
No call names the kind of change landed here.
The kind named here runs no warrant.
No reading is owed for a row landed here.
Every check that judges a write judges the rows landed here.
What an act says is one report line whole, rather than one line to each line of it.
An act saying nothing at all reports no line rather than one line holding nothing.
Neither difference shows on a terminal, where both read the same way.

definition: one act on a day's stretches, read off the checkout and landed as a commit
